column1: # vendored-files.tsv: every file under plugin/vendor, and whether the hostile-input corpus reaches it. Data, not code: a new vendored file is a new row.
# Columns, separated by one tab: path (relative to plugin/vendor), status, reason.
#   status reached  the file is a Python module a hostile-frontmatter run loads (plugin/scripts/nasty-inputs.test.sh Part C proves it)
#   status exempt   the file needs no run, and the reason says why
#   status ignore   a pattern for files that need no row at all (a match on the whole path, on the file name, or on any folder in it)
# A row is never removed because nothing failed on it. An ignore row names a pattern, not a file: it is not a duplicate of a reached or exempt row for a path the pattern happens to match.
